note: The data room's eval (docs/ASSISTANT_DATA_PLAN.md D5, ADR-0040): about 30 questions per role, asked of the real model by scripts/eval_assistant_data.py. Each case is one conversation; each turn has the question, the gold SQL (run in the role's own room on the same state copy before the model is asked, so the gold is what the data says that day) and what the answer must contain. want: v — the first cell; row — every cell of the first row; col:NAME:K — column NAME of the first K rows (all: every row); none — no rows or 0, said as 0 or as none. Numbers match with tỷ/triệu/nghìn read, within 1 % (counts under a million exactly); names match without diacritics. dispute: the person contradicts a number of the last answer, and the turn must count again with truy_van (§3.5). The RM is rm01 (C01, C04, C05); the client is C01.
